name: redteam_10_6
comment: Red team 10_6 (gap_vs_width, aimed at #7,#5,#1): The squad crosses a 2.2 m gap in a long wall at 45 deg. The pair partner's behind-right-shoulder slot (and the diamond or wedge flank slots) lands on the far side of the wall while the leader is in the gap, so the fold to a trail column comes late and the wall cuts leader-to-partner. Broke 25 (check, choice, members): #5 slots / spacing, #7 squad split by a wall. First: #5 auto n4 R1 s2 t=19.3s - L-Z 50 cm apart.
